regulator_name: Florida Construction Industry Licensing Board (DBPR CILB)

records.title: Florida Certified General Contractor (CGC): corrected 5-A qualification and licensing routes
records.overview: Selected official DBPR/CILB steps for individual Florida Certified General Contractor licensure. The 5-A qualification matrix, CGC-specific experience-area and four-story requirements, military alternatives, and four-year residential/building upgrade route are distinct. Active-status financial and insurance requirements are conditional. Out-of-state endorsement is not represented. This is not a complete eligibility determination.
records.review_note: Revision 2 rebuilds CGC qualification from the July 2024 CILB 5-A form and 2026 Florida Statutes §489.111. It corrects degree plus one-year applicable-category experience; adds the worker/foreman/college-credit and military alternatives; corrects the upgrade route to active certified residential or building license held at least four years; and adds four experience areas plus one year on four-story structures. Below-660 FICO requires the Board-approved 14-hour course; no bond substitute is claimed.

children.label: Qualify with an accredited four-year engineering, architecture or building-construction degree plus one year of proven experience in the requested category
Qualify with one year as a foreman plus at least three years of accredited college-level credits
Qualify with one year as a skilled worker, one year as a foreman and at least two years of accredited college-level credits
Qualify with two years as a skilled worker, one year as a foreman and at least one year of accredited college-level credits
Qualify with four years as a skilled worker or foreman, including at least one year as a foreman
Use the CGC upgrade method with an active current certified residential or building contractor license held at least four years
children.condition: Provide the license number for DBPR verification

children.label: Veteran route: document three years of military service and one year of applicable foreman experience
Veteran route: document two years of military service, one year of foreman experience and one year of applicable worker or foreman experience
Veteran route: document one year of military service, one year of foreman experience and two years of applicable worker or foreman experience
Document experience in at least four of the experience areas listed on CILB 5-A
Document at least one year constructing structures at least four stories high
children.condition: The 5-A form cites Rule 61G4-15.001; confirm upgrade-method treatment with DBPR

children.label: Pass the Florida Certified General Contractor state certification examination
children.condition: The application checklist requires the state certification examination before initial licensure application; no score or exam-part count is asserted

children.label: Submit required electronic fingerprints for FDLE and FBI screening
For active status, submit a FICO-derived credit report and satisfy financial-responsibility requirements
children.condition: A score of at least 660 and no unsatisfied judgments or liens meets the stated standard; below 660 requires a Board-approved 14-hour course, not an assumed bond substitute

children.label: For active status, obtain at least $300,000 public-liability and $50,000 property-damage insurance
children.condition: Inactive applicants do not complete the active-status insurance section

children.label: Obtain workers' compensation insurance or a valid exemption
children.condition: The form allows an exemption within 30 days after license issuance

children.label: Submit the completed individual CILB 5-A application and applicable fee
Receive DBPR/CILB approval and the Certified General Contractor license

records.title: Florida Certified Building Contractor (CBC): corrected 5-B qualification and licensing routes
records.overview: Selected official DBPR/CILB steps for individual Florida Certified Building Contractor licensure. The 5-B qualification matrix, four-of-six experience-area rule, military alternatives, and three-year active certified-residential upgrade route are distinct. Active-status financial and insurance requirements are conditional. Out-of-state endorsement is not represented. This is not a complete eligibility determination.
records.review_note: Revision 2 rebuilds CBC qualification from the July 2024 CILB 5-B form and 2026 Florida Statutes §489.111. It corrects degree plus one-year applicable-category experience; adds worker/foreman/college-credit and military alternatives; preserves the CBC-only upgrade route for active certified residential license held at least three years; and adds the four-of-six experience-area rule. Below-660 FICO requires the Board-approved 14-hour course; no bond substitute is claimed.
